entities.summary: Alfonso Bialetti was an Italian engineer who became famous for manufacturing the Triplerapid Miracol 900 which he modified and sold as Moka Express coffeemaker in the 1950s. Designed in 1937 by Otello Amleto Spadini, the coffee pot has been a style icon since the 1950s. While many variations of the Moka have been developed, including the Bialetti cow-printed Mukka Express, the original is considered a classic. Bialetti was also the founder of Bialetti Industries, now an Italian kitchen-ware company.
